name: theme-base
title: Theme base
description: Shared design-system CSS: imports, dark variant, @theme inline token mappings, radius scale, base type styles and DS keyframes. Sets no colors; load one theme file after it.
docs: In your CSS entry, import ds-base.css and then one theme file, and remove the @import "tailwindcss", @theme inline and :root/.dark blocks that shadcn init created. Set data-theme on <html>. See THEMING.md in the DataServices design system.
